run_connection_to_browser: run the Playwright Connection to establish a transport link with the browser server
send_message_to_server: send a method call with parameters from a ChannelOwner to the Playwright server via Connection
dispatch_server_messages: dispatch incoming server messages including __create__, __adopt__, __dispose__ and event notifications
replace_channels_with_guids: replace Channel objects in a payload dict with their guid representations for serialization
dispose_channel_owner: dispose a ChannelOwner and recursively dispose all child objects to clean up resources
